entries.zh: 叠起；把一物叠放在另一物之上
entries.en: to stack up; to pile one thing on top of another

entries.zh: 叠高；往上堆叠、放到高处
entries.en: to pile up high; to put up high

entries.zh: 叠藏；叠收藏置（收起来藏好）
entries.en: to put away hidden; to stash away

entries.zh: 夹记；夹插于其间（夹放在中间）
entries.en: to insert in between; to interpose
to set/put out a net (for catching)
entries.notes: 西文“cagar”疑为“caçar”（捕猎）之17世纪拼写；汉栏首字“常”与音写“hung”不尽吻合，仅“網（音写hǎng）”由西、汉、闽三栏互证，动词义（张、设）依赖推断。

entries.en: to set aside; to put to one side
entries.notes: 汉栏首字“廿”当系“二”之形近字（与音写首音节相应），“放一边”义与西栏poner a la banda互证清晰，不影响释义。

entries.en: to put in some place; to place somewhere

entries.zh: （在文契上）定立期限、订下日子
entries.en: to set the terms/date in a contract or document
entries.notes: 汉栏首字“會”与音写首音节（chiám）不合，或为“簽”类字形；“定日子”与西栏poner términos a la escritura（文契立定期限）互证，释义仍立。

entries.zh: 四肢着地趴伏；蹲踞其处
entries.en: to get down on all fours; to crouch/stay put
entries.notes: 西栏“四肢着地”与汉栏“控處”（音写câng zě）语义未能完全互证，释义在“趴伏”与“蹲置其处”之间，存疑。

entries.en: sunset; for the sun to go down
moonset; for the moon to set
to put on / tie on the headcloth (banquín, a netted headwrap)
entries.notes: 西语“Banquin”即闽南语“網巾”之西语借词，本条谓结（系）网巾于头。

entries.zh: 成人；十五岁束发结网巾、视为成年
entries.en: to come of age (at fifteen); to become an adult

entries.notes: 音写中段“L.”未明，然Poniente＝西已由西、汉两栏互证；马尼拉语境下poniente亦常指西风（季风）。

entries.zh: 介词：按、在（某处）；凭、依（处所义）
entries.en: preposition: at, in (a place); by, according to
entries.notes: 官话栏“càng”所对之字未能确定，然西、汉、闽三栏互证“按/在（处所）”义清晰。

entries.zh: 为、为了；因为（表原因）；为着爱惜、袒护扶助
entries.en: for, because of; for the sake of / out of love; so as to favor or support
because of, owing to; to lead to, cause

entries.notes: 音写“īn côu”为两音节而汉栏单记“故”字，盖“因故”连读，义仍为“因此”。
